paper_title: Can LLMs Solve longer Math Word Problems Better
caption: CoLeG-E (left) and CoLeg-R (right) of scaling up SFT dataset across various model scales in the LLaMA-2 family. The results suggest scaling up model scales and SFT dataset can further improve CoLeG.

annotations.annotation: The bar chart illustrates the CoLeG-R (%) performances for different models under varying conditions. The horizontal axis contains the categories labeled as "LLAMA-2-7B", "LLAMA-2-13B", and "LLAMA-2-70B". The vertical axis represents the CoLeG-R percentage, labeled as "CoLeG-R (%)" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, and numerical tick marks at intervals of 10. Each category consists of four stacked bars representing different conditions: "no SFT" in blue with white diagonal stripes, "+ SFT on D₀" in yellow with white horizontal stripes patterns, "+ SFT on D₀, D₁" in purple with slanted stripes, and "+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂" in peach with solid fill. For LLAMA-2-7B, the blue bar reaches approximately 66%, yellow at 66%, purple at around 80%, and red close to 82%. For LLAMA-2-13B, the blue bar is around 70%, yellow at 72%, purple at approximately 82%, and red about 80%. For LLAMA-2-70B, the blue bar is just above 80%, yellow at 81%, purple around 82%, and red reaching close to 80%. The bars are grouped by model type without any specific sorting and are visually emphasized with distinct color patterns for each category. A legend is given bottom right.
